name: Multivitamin with L-Lysine
indication_description:
Multivitamin with L-Lysine is indicated in-
  • Improves appetite
  • Promotes growth in height & weight
  • Helps in building of muscle protein
  • Helps to absorb Calcium
  • Ensures energy production
dosage_description:
Adult: 03 Tablets daily
Children (from 01 year of age): 1-3 Tablets daily depending on the age & physical condition
contraindications_description: The product is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to any of the active ingredients of the product.
side_effects_description: The product is usually well tolerated and exerts no untoward effects if taken in the dosage recommended.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: The specific information is not available in this respect.
storage_conditions_description: Keep container well closed after taking medicine. Store below 25°C. Protect from light & moisture. Keep out of reach of children.
